name: Glovis EV Logistics America - Savannah Integrated Warehouse (Pooler GA)

fieldNotes.UNRESOLVED: Facility could not be located. The Glovis EV Logistics America 'Savannah integrated warehouse' opened only in Q1 2026; the two primary sources (Seoul Economic Daily 2026-04-15, Korea Herald) place it only in 'Savannah, Georgia' with no street address, industrial park, or highway named. The roster itself records 'exact street address not publicly disclosed - city/ZIP only' and the geocode precision is APPROXIMATE (Pooler ZIP 31322 centroid).
fieldNotes.geocode: The roster coordinate 32.088338,-81.262896 lands inside a residential subdivision in eastern Pooler -- definitely not the warehouse. It is a ZIP centroid, not the building.
fieldNotes.research: FMCSA registers GLOVIS EV LOGISTICS AMERICA LLC at 600 Kona Drive, Ellabell GA 31308 -- that is the HMGMA Metaplant campus support address, not the new 69,000 sqm (~742,000 sqft) integrated warehouse. The Pooler / I-16 corridor contains many large speculative logistics warehouses; none is publicly attributable to Glovis from available sources.
fieldNotes.perimeter: PLACEHOLDER ONLY -- the perimeter box is a nominal ~0.2 mi square centered on the unverified ZIP-centroid coordinate. It does NOT represent a confirmed building footprint and must not be used as a real geofence.
fieldNotes.classification: All 22 classification fields are defaults (no facility imagery available) and are listed in uncertainFields. As a Glovis HMGMA-linked integrated distribution warehouse, the facility would most plausibly be a dock-door cross-dock building with a truck gate, but this is unverified.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Tentatively Rural -- the Pooler / I-16 logistics corridor is edge-of-town / interchange industrial; unverified.

citations.claim: Hyundai Glovis opened its Savannah integrated warehouse (~69,000 sqm) in Q1 2026 as a production-linked logistics hub for HMGMA; described as operational.
~30 Glovis EV Logistics America job listings in Savannah GA (May 2026) confirm an active, staffed operation.

verification.rationale: Opened Q1 2026 (source April 2026 was the press date) and operational/staffed as of mid-2026 per opening press release + May 2026 job listings; NOT under construction. Address imprecise (city/ZIP only) - flag for geocode.
